title: Product field ledger
summary: 141 fields of a product, each with its meaning, origin, the one source, who sets it, what checks it, every view that shows it, what reads it, and its test. ✓ complete 50 · findings on the rest. Plan: C:/dev/FIELD-LEDGER-PLAN.md. Human table: C:/dev/toolset/fields/FIELDS-product.md.
raised_by: Athi, 2026-10-09 ("create the ledger and connect to cmdb")

entries.d: A person types or picks the keyed fields; the form reads only the inputs on screen.
Declares columns and bulk-writes fields from a sheet.
Starter catalogues and goods-in write fields no form shows.
Cost, availability and stock arrive from the books.

process.d: ONE jsonb bag; schema_fields declares the keys, nothing in the database binds them. This ledger is the declaration the database does not hold.
The till, the customer copy and the export each read a different subset.

exits.d: What the shopkeeper and the customer see at the counter.
What a customer sees, after exposure strips.
A new column, a new form input, or a reader of a not-used field fails the build until this ledger says why.

relationships.that: CAP-CATSETUP — sets the columns, import, tax-slab and pricing fields
CAP-ADOPT — writes code, unit, price, aliases, batch_tracked on goods-in adoption
CAP-DEFINITIONS — owns the tax slab, pricing structure and category definitions that fields cite or copy
CAP-NETWORK — shows and merges adopted lines (commercials, source_ref)
CAP-MATCH — reads synonyms, code, sku, aliases to match a message to a product
CAP-CONNECTOR — feeds cost, avail and stock into fields
CAP-SUPPLIES — owns the supply items that share stock_balance with products
CAP-CHIT2 — shows product fields on the chit/bill detail

tests.proves: every product column and form input has a row; a not-used field gains no reader; every row obeys the shape.
the fields shape refuses a contradictory row; flags count shown-nowhere / not-used / untested.

descriptor: Counts: ok 50 · shown-nowhere 15 · not-settable 8 · two-sources 31 · no-meaning 8 · untested 22 · not-used 7. Garbage: G1 Object-store bytes of a removed product; G2 catalogue_item_version rows (b146 trigger); G3 catalogue_item_schedule applied / cancelled rows; G4 counter_hidden_item and quick_key_group_item rows of removed products; G5 Alias and legacy keys left inside item_data (category, description, ean, hsn_code, names, qty); G6 Declared columns nobody uses (schema_fields rows with 0 products); G7 Copy fields: tax_slab_name, gst_rate, category_names, pricing_* travelling copies. Survey: migrations/READ-2026-10-09-product-field-survey.sql (Athi runs it; results go into each row as initialised % · dangling n · stale n).
